hypothesis: Last-glyph 1px right-edge rounding tie on justified lines

census_across_5_corpora.criterion: Justified lines where shifting only gs[-1].x by -1 px makes the rendered line band 100% bitwise equal to the device capture

candidates_tested.candidate: (a) Change place_phase from 0.5 to 0.49 in Config
candidates_tested.result: REJECTED — shifts hundreds of interior glyphs at (pos26 & 63) == 32 across all 5 corpora, dropping exact pages.

candidates_tested.candidate: (b) Floor/round-half-down only on last glyph of justified lines when ((start26 + off) & 63) == 32
candidates_tested.result: REJECTED — while helping 34 lines across the 5 corpora, it regresses 61 lines that are ALREADY 100% bitwise identical at the exact same terminal glyph x-coordinate (4 on exam1, 8 on exam3_normal, 49 on exam3_small), violating the zero-regression gate.

candidates_tested.candidate: (c) Unrounded float accumulation of glyph advances across the line before quantizing the terminal glyph
candidates_tested.result: REJECTED — sub-26.6 float accumulation drifts from Kindle's per-word/per-space 26.6 fixed-point placement on 61 currently exact lines.

decision: Keep place_phase = 0.5 unchanged per Stage E2 rule ('Accept only if zero regressions').
